subject: Communication Systems
questionText:
What will be the maximum allowable bit rate if 
coherent BPSK signaling scheme is used?

28.4 kbps 
(b) 2.84 kbps 
 
(c) 
1.18 kbps 
(d) 11.8 kbps

kbps on a radio channel having 400 kHz bandwidth
explanation: Practice Question from Communication Systems DPP-06 (PRACTICE SHEET 01).
